item.title: Ahbar Günlük Bülten — Sayı #32 (2026-11-19)
item.description:
Ahbar Sayı #32 (2026-11-19):
1. [Bilgisayar Bilimi & Yazılım] Discord Patch Notes: November 9, 2026. Check out the finer details of the more technical fixes implemented into Discord recently. — Discord Systems & Database Engineering (Bilgisayar Bilimi & Yazılım) Bilgisayar Bilimi & Yazılım alanında Discord Systems & Database Engineering tarafından yayımlanan teknik araştırma ve analiz raporu: Check out the finer details of the more technical fixes implemented into Discord recently.
2. [Yapay Zekâ & Makine Öğrenmesi] WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules. Rules govern how player actions change interactive worlds. — Hugging Face Daily Papers (Yapay Zekâ & Makine Öğrenmesi) Yapay Zekâ & Makine Öğrenmesi alanında Hugging Face Daily Papers tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: Rules govern how player actions change interactive worlds. Different rules create distinct gameplay experiences within similar scenes and action spaces. For customizable gameplay, generative world models must follow user-defined rules beyond real-world behaviors.
3. [Matematik & Biçimsel Bilimler] An Atiyah--Hirzebruch to Adams map and the hastened Adams spectral sequence for supercohomology — arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) (Matematik & Biçimsel Bilimler) Matematik & Biçimsel Bilimler alanında arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: We construct a map of filtered spectra inducing a map from the Atiyah--Hirzebruch spectral sequence (AHSS) to the Baker--Lazarev Adams spectral sequence of a $\mathit{ko}$-module $M$. Using this and a theorem of Bruner--Rognes, we construct a hastened Adams spectral sequence (HASS) for the Postnikov truncations of $\mathit{ko}$ and the connective Adams summand. Then, motivated by questions in quantum field theory, topological phases of matter, and tensor category theory, we apply the HASS to supercohomology, the cohomology theory $I_{\mathbb{C}^\times}(τ_{\le 2}\mathit{ko})$, and observe that in examples of interest it is easier to calculate with than either the AHSS or the usual Adams spectral sequence.
4. [Fizik, Kuantum & Uzay] Residual Allan Stability under Periodic Auxiliary Ramsey Sampling — arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) (Fizik, Kuantum & Uzay) Fizik, Kuantum & Uzay alanında arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: The timing of auxiliary Ramsey measurements can change the frequency stability associated with a drifting pulse shift at a fixed nominal Fisher-information rate for a constant shift. For periodic instantaneous observations of an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck shift with causal prediction between updates, we derive the exact residual covariance averaged over the update cycle and the corresponding Allan variance at arbitrary averaging times. Relative to a continuous Kalman reference at the same information rate, periodic estimation increases the cycle-averaged estimation-error variance, reduces the short-time residual Allan variance, and increases its long-time value.
5. [Sistem, Donanım & Tüketici Teknolojisi] Security updates for Wednesday — LWN.net (Linux & Kernel Engineering) (Sistem, Donanım & Tüketici Teknolojisi) Sistem, Donanım & Tüketici Teknolojisi alanında LWN.net (Linux & Kernel Engineering) tarafından yayımlanan teknik araştırma ve analiz raporu: Security updates have been issued by AlmaLinux (.NET 10.0, .NET 11.0, .NET 8.0, .NET 9.0, bind, bind9.18, buildah, c-ares, cjose, cockpit, cockpit-files, cockpit-machines, cockpit-podman, containernetworking-plugins, crun, delve, dhcp, dogtag-pki, dovecot, dpdk, edk2, emacs, environment-modules, expat, fetchmail, firefox, flatpak, flatpak-builder, freerdp, gcc, gcc-toolset-15-gcc, gcc-toolset-16-gcc, git-lfs, glib2,…
6. [Biyoteknoloji, Tıp & Malzeme Bilimi] HARICOT: De Novo Assembly of Raw Nanopore Signals using Fuzzy de Bruijn Graphs — bioRxiv Bioinformatics Preprints (Biyoteknoloji, Tıp & Malzeme Bilimi) Biyoteknoloji, Tıp & Malzeme Bilimi alanında bioRxiv Bioinformatics Preprints tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: Nanopore sequencing enables reading long nucleotide sequences by measuring characteristic changes in ionic current as molecules pass through a nanopore. These current measurements, known as raw signals, can be analyzed without translating them into bases (i.e., without basecalling), which provides fast and resource-efficient genome analysis. Prior work, Rawsamble, enables finding overlaps between raw nanopore signals, without basecalling them, and generating assemblies from these overlaps with off-the-shelf assemblers such as miniasm.
7. [Kriptografi, Web3 & Dağıtık Protokoller] Possible futures of the Ethereum protocol, part 6: The Splurge — Vitalik Buterin's Blog (Kriptografi, Web3 & Dağıtık Protokoller) Kriptografi, Web3 & Dağıtık Protokoller alanında Vitalik Buterin's Blog tarafından yayımlanan teknik araştırma ve analiz raporu: Published via Vitalik Buterin's Blog in Cryptography, Web3 & Protocols. Primary discussion and technical specification available at the linked source.
8. [Ekonomi, Finans & Makro Analiz] The Structural Number of Parties: An Electoral-Outcome-Independent Baseline for Comparing Party-System Scale — arXiv Economics (econ.EM, econ.GN, econ.TH) (Ekonomi, Finans & Makro Analiz) Ekonomi, Finans & Makro Analiz alanında arXiv Economics (econ.EM, econ.GN, econ.TH) tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: How many parties can a country structurally sustain? Standard measures such as the effective number of parties (ENP) cannot answer this question. They are descriptive and post hoc: they summarize competition only after an election, and they depend on electoral returns that are often missing, interrupted, or unreliable in many developing democracies, particularly in Africa.
9. [Uluslararası İlişkiler, Jeopolitik & Strateji] The Paradox of Dollar Dominance. 10. [Bilim Felsefesi, Karar Kuramı & Bilişsel Bilimler] Sharp Complexity Thresholds for Network Cournot Competition — arXiv Game Theory, Complex Systems & Soc-Phys (cs.GT, nlin.AO, physics.soc-ph) (Bilim Felsefesi, Karar Kuramı & Bilişsel Bilimler) Bilim Felsefesi, Karar Kuramı & Bilişsel Bilimler alanında arXiv Game Theory, Complex Systems & Soc-Phys (cs.GT, nlin.AO, physics.soc-ph) tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: We determine the approximation complexity of network Cournot equilibrium as a function of demand degree and the number of firms sharing a market. For common, nonincreasing concave polynomial inverse demands, convex quadratic costs of firms' allocation vectors, and rational total capacities, high-precision approximation is polynomial-time solvable for cubic demands, regardless of market size. Quartic demands remain tractable when each market has at most three firms, and quintic demands remain tractable with at most two.
